summary: Driver App + POD tested end-to-end on both backend and frontend. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing (upload auth 401/non-image 422/happy path + files GET with ?token=; driver /home shape + RBAC 403 for customer; full state machine start->arrive->unload->pod DISPATCHED->EN_ROUTE->AT_SITE->UNLOADING->DELIVERED with 409 for invalid transition; order history contains EN_ROUTE/AT_SITE/UNLOADING/POD_PENDING/DELIVERED; attendance checkin/double-checkin 409/checkout gating). Frontend (Expo web 390x844): driver login (+919000000002, OTP auto-filled) routes to /driver with tabs Home/Trips/Attendance/More. Active-trip card opens /trip/{id}; the single 'trip-advance' button progresses Start Trip -> Reached Site -> Start Unloading (status pill updates Dispatched -> EN ROUTE -> ARRIVED -> UNLOADING and progress bar advances); at UNLOADING the button switches to a separate testID 'trip-pod' labelled 'Complete Delivery (POD)' which routes to /pod/{id}. POD screen accepts receiver+qty; drawing on the SVG signature pad via mouse.down/move/up registered strokes; tapping 'pod-submit' succeeded WITHOUT a photo (as noted in the review), redirecting to /driver with 'Delivered today' incrementing (4 -> 5). Attendance tab renders 'On Duty' with check-in time and a 'Check Out' button (testID='checkout-btn'). Regression: customer login (+919000000001) -> /customer and owner login (owner@trackmyrmc.test) -> /owner both verified.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings still logged during driver flow. Reference: multiple components.

action_items: (Optional) Attendance testIDs use inconsistent naming: /driver/attendance uses 'checkout-btn' while the rest of the driver flow uses 'tab-*', 'trip-*', 'pod-*' patterns. Consider renaming to 'attendance-checkin' / 'attendance-checkout' for consistency and easier automated testing.
(Optional cleanup) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props -> boxShadow and props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Driver router (/api/driver): STEP_MAP is clean, trip ownership guarded by driver_id, POD submit is idempotent (upsert), vehicle is released back to 'available' on POD, and audit is written. Notifications pushed to customer at each stage.

Storage router (/api/upload, /api/files): uses run_in_threadpool for blocking requests calls (good), lazy re-init on 503, and rejects non-image content-types (422). Files GET accepts both Bearer header and ?token= query so RN Image / both work.
POD screen (/app/frontend/app/pod/[id].tsx) correctly submits with just receiver+qty+signature; photo is optional; signature stored as JSON string of SVG paths.
Trip screen splits progression into 'trip-advance' (start/arrive/unload) and 'trip-pod' (POD) — good UX but the review-request expected a single flow; documented in action_items.
seed_data_creation: Consumed the existing DRIVER_ASSIGNED order RMC-1006 (TS09UB5678) via challan+dispatch, then delivered it via the driver UI (frontend). Also seeded a fresh RMC-1010 during the frontend run. Fleet is now: TS09UB1234 assigned to next queued trip RMC-1003 (ASSIGNED), TS09UB5678 available, TS09UB9012 maintenance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver testIDs: driver-theme-toggle, active-trip-card, tab-home, tab-trips, tab-attendance, tab-more, trip-back, trip-navigate, trip-advance (start/arrive/unload), trip-pod (UNLOADING -> POD), pod-back, pod-receiver, pod-qty, pod-remarks, pod-camera, pod-gallery, pod-photo-remove, pod-sign-clear, pod-signature, pod-submit, checkout-btn (attendance). Signature must be drawn via mouse.down/move/up on the signature area — a simple click does not create strokes. POD photo is optional on web (camera/gallery permissions typically not available in Playwright). To seed a fresh dispatched trip, use owner /api/owner/fleet -> pick a vehicle with status='available'; TS09UB5678 usually stays available after POD but check first. Vehicle TS09UB9012 is permanently in 'maintenance'. Order-detail response is wrapped as {order:{...}, history:[...]}, history items have keys 'to' (not 'to_status').
